name: Dong Ho folk woodblock painting
aliases: Tranh khắc gỗ dân gian Đông Hồ
region: Dong Ho village, Bac Ninh, Vietnam
summary: Villagers print a black outline block, then add flat colour blocks one by one on do paper that carries a coat of scallop-shell powder. The colours come from plants and minerals, so they are bright and flat.

philosophy.core_thesis: A village can print a whole folk art from plant and mineral colour, one flat block at a time, on paper that shines with ground shell.
design_principles: Print the black outline block first. Keep the line coarse and 1–3 mm wide.
Add 4–5 flat colour blocks one by one, in order from light to dark, with no gradation.
Use opaque colour: sophora yellow, leaf green, red and shell white.
Use motifs for the New Year (Tet): a carp, a pig with chicks, a rooster and a wedding of rats.
Cut a caption in the block, or write it by hand, as a proverb or a wish.
Let the colour shift 1–2 mm from the outline. Keep the wood grain in the large fields.
Print on do paper that has a coat of scallop-shell powder, so the sheet sparkles.
anti_patterns: Fine hatching or a thin, delicate line
A colour set that no plant or mineral gives

process.matrix: Blocks of jackfruit or persimmon wood, one for each colour, and an outline block that prints first.
process.press: No press. A printer presses the block on the paper by hand, and rubs the back with a pad.
process.image_making: Family workshops copy and recut old motifs for the New Year. The village shares the designs.

inks.strategy: Colour from plants and minerals, mixed with rice paste. The outline prints first in black, then 4–5 flat colour blocks, then a rice-paste coat.

colours.name: Red from Thien Thai gravel or sappanwood

screening.rule: Make each tone a flat opaque field of one colour. The style has no gradation and no screen.

registration.rule: Allow 1–2 mm of shift between the colour blocks and the black outline, and keep it.

substrate.stock: Do paper of the bark of the do tree, coated with scallop-shell powder (điệp).
substrate.finish: A shell coat that glitters, and a final coat of rice paste.

surface.impression: Light. The sheet lies almost flat.
surface.sheen: A fine sparkle from the shell powder, and a matt colour.
surface.texture: A grainy, glittering ground, flat colour with the wood grain in it, and a coarse black line.

marks: wood grain in the solid areas

positive: carp and pig motifs for Tet

evidence.title: Dong Ho painting - Ly Ngu vong nguyet

emotion.target_response: Warm, plain luck: the viewer feels a village joke and a wish for the New Year, in colour that is simple and strong.

use_cases: packs for Vietnamese food and craft
avoid_when: The brief needs soft gradation or fine detail.
The picture needs a photographic or glossy look.

modifiers.how: Add vermilion and a hand-painted face or robe, and fill the sheet with auspicious motifs.
Thin the key line to 0.3 mm, print on washi, and add a wiped gradation to the sky.
